result.summary: The page is generally well laid out, but one restaurant card has a visibly broken/missing image and some horizontally scrolling content is clipped at the right edge.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a gray placeholder with a broken-image icon instead of a restaurant image, making the card look unfinished or failed to load.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image URL/loading state and provide a branded fallback image if the restaurant photo is unavailable.

issues.description: The rightmost category chip and restaurant cards are visibly cut off at the right edge. While this may indicate horizontal carousels, the clipping is abrupt and does not clearly communicate that more content can be swiped.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer horizontal-scroll affordance, such as partial-card spacing, a fade/gradient edge, or carousel indicators, while ensuring item text is not unnecessarily truncated.
